sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionists and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for opposite party no.2 are present.
Since both these criminal revisions arise out of the same order, therefore, they are being decided together by a common order.

Both these criminal revisions have been filed against impugned order dated 22.11.2022 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.1, Mathura in Special Session Case No.3140 of 2018 (State Versus Manveer) arising out of Case Crime No.380 of 2017 under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Baldev, District Mathura.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.1, Mathura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By the impugned order, learned trial court in exercise of powers under Section 319 Cr.P.C., on an application of prosecution/first informant, has summoned the revisionists-accused, Manveer and Gopal and two others, Suresh and Sunil to face trial with for the offence under Sections 363,366,
376-D I.P.C. and 5/6 of POCSO Act.
It is contended by learned counsel for the revisionists that the F.I.R. of this case was lodged against Manveer and Suresh for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act.
After investigation charge-sheet was submitted only against the Manveer for offence under Sections 363,366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act.
The trial court framed charges against Manveer in aforesaid sections.
During trial, after examination of two witnesses, an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. was moved by the prosecution to summon Suresh, Gopal and Sunil also.
The learned trial court by the impugned order has summoned revisionists for the offence under Sections 363,366, 376D I.P.C. and 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel contended that Manveer was already charge-sheeted and facing trial.
Charge was framed against him, so there was no occasion to pass summoning order against Manveer under Section 319 Cr.P.C.
At this stage, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2-first informant submitted that the matter may be remitted back to the trial court to pass a fresh order.
In view of the submissions made by counsel for the parties, both these criminal revisions are allowed.
The impugned order dated 22.11.2022 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.1, Mathura in aforesaid case is set aside.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.1, Mathura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned trial court is directed to pass fresh order in view of the observation made in this order within a period of three weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is filed before it.
